lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-lateral plane but shows increased compression and irregularity at the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Superior terminal bifurcation observed on the 3rd anterior line near the dorsal ridge; a minor Y-shaped merging pattern is visible on the 10th line in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1, 11, and 12 terminate mid-torso before reaching the ventral boundary; line 9 exhibits a distinct central discontinuity.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of approximately 6 high-contrast white spots located on the lower posterior haunch with higher density near the distal edge of the thigh.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of 3 distinct spots on the mid-posterior haunch forming a semi-linear geometric sequence.

other_distinctive_markers: White inter-ocular chevron pattern; dark distal limb pigmentation starting below the carpal/tarsal joints; white throat patch visible on the ventral neck region.
